mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET nickname=#{nickname} WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT context_reset_turn FROM learner_profile WHERE subject_key=#{subject} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(t.id),0) FROM conversation_turn t JOIN training_session s ON s.id=t.session_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE subject_key=#{subject} AND memory_key=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_long_term_memory(subject_key,memory_key,memory_type,content,source_session,source_turn,confirmation,confirmed_at,expires_at) VALUES(#{subject},#{key},#{type},#{content},'profile',#{turn},'EXPLICIT',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 180 DAY)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE memory_type=VALUES(memory_type),content=VALUES(content),source_session='profile',source_turn=VALUES(source_turn), confirmation='EXPLICIT',confirmed_at=VALUES(confirmed_at),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at)
